species.tagline: The commonest swallowtail at Hong Kong Wetland Park

tasks.title: Look at the wings
tasks.hint: Turn it and look at the wings
tasks.message: The female has a row of white spots on her hindwings, like a string of beads.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a common mormon. Her hindwings carry a row of white spots.

tasks.title: A great pretender
tasks.message: The female copies a poisonous butterfly, so birds leave her alone.
tasks.subtitle: She is not poisonous. She just looks like a butterfly that is — so birds keep away.

tasks.title: This is a real specimen
tasks.message: This is not a drawing — it is a 3D scan of a real butterfly.
tasks.subtitle: This butterfly was scanned from a real specimen, so you can turn it all the way round.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: More flowers means more food for butterflies.
tasks.subtitle: Butterflies need nectar to fly. Leaving flowers helps them stay. Thank you!
